review_candidates.description: Summary Synera Renewable Energy (SRE) is a leading offshore wind developer with a portfolio of projects across Taiwan and Asia. We are seeking an experienced Subsea Cables Transport and Installation (T&I) Lead to lead the integrated planning and execution of export and inter-array cable transport and installation. You will manage T&I Managers responsible for the export cable (EXP) and inter-array cable (IAC) scopes respectively, with accountability for safety, quality, budget, schedule and contractor performance across cable T&I activities. Working closely with the Subsea Cable Package Manager and Cable Supply Manager, you will align cable delivery, vessel readiness and offshore installation campaigns. The role covers installation engineering, marine logistics, load-out, cable laying, burial and protection, pull-in, jointing, termination and testing through to completion and handover. Scope Description As a key member of the Synera Renewable Energy team, your role will encompass the following: Lead the combined EXP and IAC T&I scopes from strategy and procurement through transport, installation engineering, offshore execution and handover. Manage the EXP and IAC T&I Managers, setting clear responsibilities, priorities and consistent delivery standards. Develop the integrated T&I execution strategy, budget and schedule, incorporating vessel requirements, weather constraints, seabed conditions and project milestones. Lead T&I tender evaluations and support contractor selection and contract negotiations with the Package Manager, procurement, commercial and legal teams. Oversee T&I contract delivery, contractor performance, variations and claims, escalating key risks and decisions to the Package Manager. Oversee transport and installation engineering and methods, ensuring survey findings, cable characteristics, burial requirements and seabed risks are incorporated. Coordinate with the Cable Supply Manager to align manufacturing, storage, load-out and delivery with installation campaign requirements. Manage interfaces with substations, WTGs, foundations, ports and other marine contractors, ensuring coordinated access and offshore activities. Drive safety by design and oversee marine assurance, vessel mobilisation and offshore readiness, including permits, procedures, resources and emergency arrangements. Oversee cable installation, burial and protection, pull-in, jointing, termination and testing through the EXP and IAC T&I Managers. Monitor costs, progress, risks and quality across both scopes, driving corrective actions and resolution of non-conformities and defects. Lead T&I completion and handover, ensuring acceptance criteria, as-built records, burial and protection evidence, and outstanding actions are addressed. Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in marine, mechanical, civil, electrical or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Substantial experience delivering offshore cable installation projects, with a proven track record in T&I management or senior offshore construction leadership. Demonstrated experience managing both export and inter-array cable installation scopes. Proven ability to lead managers and multidisciplinary teams, coordinating multiple contractors and offshore campaigns. Strong practical knowledge of cable installation engineering, vessel capabilities, marine logistics, cable laying, burial and protection, pull-in, jointing, termination and testing. Experience developing installation strategies, budgets and schedules, including vessel procurement, mobilisation and management of weather and seabed risks. Proven experience evaluating tenders and managing major offshore installation contracts, including variations, claims and contractor performance. Strong understanding of cable supply and installation interfaces, including handling limits, load-out arrangements and delivery sequencing. A strong commitment to HSE, with practical experience in safety by design, marine assurance and offshore operational risk management. Familiarity with applicable marine and cable installation standards, certification and permitting requirements; experience in Taiwan would be an advantage. Strong leadership, commercial judgement and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve complex issues and drive timely decisions. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken; Mandarin proficiency would be an advantage. Willingness to be based in Taipei and travel to ports, contractor facilities and offshore project sites as required.

Responsabilités principales  Participer au processus global de recrutement : publication des offres, sélection des candidats, entretien avec les managers pour comprendre les profils recherchés, premiers entretiens avec les candidats, rapport d’entretien.    Comprendre et appliquer les processus de recrutement définis avec la DRH et la responsable RH.    Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de recrutement innovantes et efficaces pour attirer des candidats qualifiés à l’échelle mondiale, en utilisant une variété de canaux de recrutement.    Effectuer une recherche active des talents via des bases de données, des réseaux professionnels, des événements de recrutement, des médias sociaux et d'autres plateformes pour identifier des candidats potentiels.    Évaluer les candidatures en fonction des compétences, de l'expérience, de la culture organisationnelle et des exigences spécifiques du poste, en menant des entretiens téléphoniques, vidéo et en personne.   Qualifications requises  Bac + 3 minimum en ressources humaines, en psychologie industrielle, en gestion des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.  Expérience préalable significative dans le recrutement international, de préférence dans un environnement multiculturel.  Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale. Très bon en français et avoir un niveau avancé en anglais (obligatoire)  Solides compétences en organisation, en gestion du temps et en priorisation des tâches.  Ce que nous offrons Travail du Lundi au Vendredi Cantine offerte Compensation attrayante: fixe + diverses primes Couverture santé dès l'embauche

review_candidates.title: Video Editor
review_candidates.description: Location: 656/82 CMT8, Nhieu Loc Ward HCMC Employment Type: Full-time, On-site Working Time: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM, Monday - Friday Salary Range: 9M - 11M ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team and work across multiple brands and projects. In this role, you will create engaging video content for a diverse portfolio of brands that are entering, expanding, or establishing their presence in new markets. Each brand has its own identity, audience, and communication style, so the ideal candidate should be highly adaptable and able to translate different brand directions into compelling visual content. You will collaborate closely with our Brand & Social Media Executive, and Designer to produce videos for social media, digital campaigns, brand awareness, product/service promotions, and other marketing initiatives. WHAT YOU'LL DO Edit and produce high-quality video content for multiple brands across different industries and markets. Transform raw footage, scripts, creative briefs, and existing assets into polished and compelling videos. Apply creative storytelling techniques to enhance content flow, pacing, and impact. Add music, sound effects, graphics, and visual effects to elevate video quality. Ensure brand consistency across all video deliverables (motion graphics, typography, storytelling). Adapt editing styles, pacing, visual language, and storytelling approaches according to each brand's identity, target audience, and market positioning. Maintain consistency with each brand's visual guidelines while adapting content to local market trends and audience preferences. Organize and maintain video files, raw footage, project files, templates, and other creative assets. Research and stay up to date with editing trends, platform algorithm changes, and content performance insights. Proactively suggest creative ideas and editing approaches that can improve engagement and strengthen brand presence. Revise and improve video content based on internal. Perform other creative and video-related tasks as required by the Social Media Manager. REQUIREMENTS Proven experience as a Video Editor, with a strong portfolio or reels (experience in comestic, or luxury brand is a plus). Strong portfolio of engaging short-form video content for social media platforms (IG, Reels, TikTok, YouTube, Stories). Proficiency in industry-standard editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or equivalent). Good written and verbal English communication skills.  Knowledge of motion graphics and color grading (After Effects or similar tools is a bonus). Solid understanding of social media trends, engagement tactics, and platform best practices. Basic photography skills. An eye for luxury aesthetics and brand consistency. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive remuneration package. A multi-national and friendly working environment. Opportunities to leverage AI-powered tools to enhance your daily work and productivity. Regular team-building events. Annual salary and performance review
